program.name: Strength & Stretch 35
program.subject: Strength & stretch
program.blurb: Thirty-five minutes: a full-body lift, then a flow from head to hips.
program.about: Strength and stretching in about half an hour. Each day lifts the whole body in straight sets, a squat or hinge, a press and a row, then flows through the hips, spine and shoulders. Two days alternate the lifts. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Full body A & flow / full body B & flow, 35 minutes
